description.value:
You have studied a sister Cloth's art.

Learn the 1st (Signature) Technique of a Cloth other than your own. It uses your Cosmo DC and focus pool normally, but it heightens one step behind your own Techniques — treat it as gained 2 levels later than you actually gained it.

You may retrain which Technique this is when you gain a level. You cannot select another Cloth's 2nd, 3rd, or 4th Technique this way — only its Signature.
